title: Where to get the elementary flow list for the AGRIBALYSE import
scope: The harmonised-flows-simple.json.gz input to the AGRIBALYSE 3.2 Brightway import.
observation: A user preparing a Brightway 2.5 import found the flow list described as a local file and asked where to obtain it.
method: The merged change adds the command `uv run dds-fetch-harmonised-flows`. It retrieves Brightway Flows 1.1.0 and checks the downloaded file against the pinned checksum.

closed.reason: The import maintainers closed the question when they merged the download command and setup instructions. The change concerns how users prepare the import.
